question: Which of the following species was among the species classified as ‘endangered migratory species’ by the UN's Convention on Conservation of Migratory Species in February 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengal Florican**__.

__
 
• **Bengal Florican was among the species classified as ‘endangered migratory species’ by the UN's Convention on Conservation of Migratory Species in February 2020.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Great Indian Bustard, Asian Elephant and Bengal Florican **have been classified as "endangered migratory species" by a UN Convention on Conservation of Migratory Species.
 
• **Bengal Florican:**
 
 
• It is a** bustard species **that is native to the **Indian subcontinent, Cambodia, and Vietnam**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f79c70d7636cb85081387ece4debfc565aac2036cfa7a6b7aa4edfc718801991.png] 

 
• **Convention on the Conservation of Migratory Species of Wild Animals Conference of the Parties (CMS COP13):**

 
 
• The meeting was concluded at Gandhinagar, Gujarat.
 
• The meeting was the first of a series of international nature-related meetings in 2020.
 
• Ten new species were added to CMS Appendices at COP13, out of these seven species were added to Appendix I, which provides the strictest protection and they are the **Asian Elephant, Jaguar, Great Indian Bustard, Bengal Florican, Little Bustard, Antipodean Albatross and the Oceanic White-tip Shark.**
